name: chantiers-en-collision
description: Worksite collision detection for Jira: every work in progress has a footprint on the repo, overlaps are flagged before the first line is written. Forge app - Codegeist 2026.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:manifest && npm run test
scripts.build:site: esbuild site/demo/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Chantiers --alias:node:crypto=./site/demo/crypto-stub.ts --minify --outfile=site/dist/demo.js && cp site/index.html site/styles.css site/dist/
